title: Ridge Line
subtitle: Beginner mission · 2 vs 2 · about 40 minutes
coachNotes: A lance is just a team. Side A has two ’Mechs; Side B has two.
No overheating and no punching in this mission — only walking (or jumping) and shooting.
If a ’Mech’s Structure hits 0, it can still shoot this turn. Take it off the table when you Clean up.
tableSteps: Lay Grassland #2 and Desert #2 from A Game of Armored Combat side by side, long sides touching (the pair the box’s first scenario uses), or use any open table about 36 × 22 inches.
Keep a tape measure in inches handy. Ignore printed hexes — just measure freely.
Woods (trees) are the only terrain that matters: moving through them costs extra inches, and shooting into or past them is a little harder.
Skip hills, water, and buildings for this first game.
Each side places its two ’Mechs within 6 inches of its own short table edge. After the first dice roll, the winner picks which side places first; then take turns placing one ’Mech at a time.
winningSummary: Knock out both enemy ’Mechs (their Structure hits 0). If anyone is still standing after 6 turns, the side with more Structure left wins. Same Structure is a draw. The turn limit is a Mech Buddy rule; the rulebook has none.

layout.openTable: No maps? Any open table about 36 × 22 inches works. Add the terrain where the diagram shows it.
